messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected on api-prod (route: /v1/generate). threshold: >2% for 5m. triggered at 2025-05-03T18:15:01Z
maria: saw the bot. I'm on call, pulling up current graphs.
maria: initial look — error-rate spikes coincide with increased batch size from a single client (billing: internal-batch-job).
lee: @maria can you confirm which model variant? we should check model-fallback logs.
maria: appears to be routed to 'redwood-llama-13b-q4'. fallback events yes ~18:16 UTC.
sam: I'm going to mute noisy alert for this route while we investigate — setting suppression for 30m. will post what I change. :lock:
ops-bot: suppression applied by sam for channel eng-sre (30m) — reason: ongoing investigation.
jordan: marking customer-impact as possible for some API clients. adding tag: partial-degradation.
alex: @maria can you estimate affected % of requests? need to page CS if >5% of active tenants.
maria: rough calc from logs: ~4.8% of total requests in the 10m window; heavy skew to internal-batch-job. not org-wide.
sam: ok no wide customer page then. will keep incident channel open.
maria: mitigation: rolled back a recent routing rule that increased max_batch_size from 64->256 for that client. rollback at 18:19 UTC.
lee: after rollback, error rate dropped but not fully back to baseline. investigating cache warm-up / KV miss spike.
jordan: can we add a temporary automatic fallback to a smaller batch-executing runtime? we had that policy but it didn't trigger.
maria: it didn't because the fallback threshold checks for latency > 2000ms; here errors were 5xx from OOM during batched request. fallback logic needs a 5xx trigger.
alex: note for postmortem: fallback rules need to watch backend error rate in addition to latency.
sam: action: create a dashboard for retrospectives showing golden signals + routing events + runbook links. I'll own the PR.
maria: suggested panels: 
- error rate (5xx) by route (p95/p99 and absolute counts)
- request latency distribution (p50/p95/p99)
- batch size histogram by client id
- backend GPU memory usage (per-pool)
- KV cache hit ratio and prefix cache eviction rate
- model fallback events timeline (annotated)
- request queue depth and dispatch wait time
- rate of model-variant rollouts / config changes

maria: also add drilldowns from each panel to traces (tempo) and to the exact log query in Loki.
lee: for alert tuning: recommend switching route-error-rate alert from p95 ratio to absolute error-rate >1% for 5m and add a for: 10m to reduce noise. also add suppression if source is a known internal-batch client.
jordan: +1. We should also change evaluation window from 1m to 5m for batch-related alerts to avoid blips.
alex: I'll open the alert change RFC in the infra repo and reference the incident in the PR. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-5xx
sam: creating grafana board: folder = "incidents/postmortems/2025-05-03-api-5xx". Title: "postmortem: api-prod 5xx spike (2025-05-03)". Adding panels now.
sam: panel configs (draft snippet):
```
- panel: error-rate-by-route
  query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",route!="/health"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route!="/health"}[5m]))
  thresholds: [0.005, 0.02]
  alert: greater than 0.01 for 10m
- panel: batch-size-hist
  query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, client_id))
```

maria: include a small on-call playbook section in the dashboard: steps to rollback routing, how to mute alerts, where to check cache/kv stats, and how to trigger the smaller-batch routing.
lee: owners for dashboard panels: infra-observability for infra metrics, eng-runtime for GPU/kernel panels, and eng-serving for route/error panels. please add ownership tags.
jordan: follow-up tasks (assigned):
- sam: create dashboard + PR with panel JSON and links (due 2025-05-06)
- alex: open RFC for alert threshold and fallback rule change (due 2025-05-07)
- lee: patch fallback logic to include 5xx health checks (draft by 2025-05-08)
- maria: add runbook section and update incident notes (due 2025-05-06)

ops-bot: Handoff scheduled: sam -> lee at 2025-05-03T19:00:00Z (local oncall rotation).
sam: handing over - logs and timeline in the dashboard notes. ping me if it resurfaces.
lee: taking over. I'll watch for any regression and keep suppression until we confirm stable for 1h.
maria: thanks all. I'll add customer-impact summary for CS: affected internal-batch-job tenants only, estimated request failure rate ~4.8% during peak, mitigated via routing rollback at 18:19 UTC.
jordan: great. We'll include this in the postmortem and note the alert tuning decisions and dashboard link. :memo:
